title: Great App, Minor updates
body:
Hello there, I have been using the ticktick app for more than 2 years now and I absolutely love the app. It has become an essential part of day to day life. Today the Daylight saving hours have started/ended for a lot of regions. My app didn’t update based on the system timing. There is no option to change it manually. Please try to resolve this asap. I almost missed a meeting due to the issue. It doesn’t work as expected and also it didn’t update the future tasks as well. This might a huge hit for people depending on the app for their entire routine. Hope to hear from the team soon!!

Update: There was a slight delay (a weeks delay) in the US timing and the European timing when the day-light savings changed. The app updated perfectly when both the location adapted to the daylight savings. (If needed you can consider this case; It’s a rare case that people miss out during testing). Apart from that I love the app and it’s a vital part of my life. Updating the review with 5 stars. Kudos to the team.
